entries.test: Contemporary reporting (e.g. NYT, January 2023) on whether Google brought Larry Page and Sergey Brin back in to help respond to ChatGPT, and whether that was tied to the state of Google Search.
entries.note: He said Google had 'obfuscated the purpose' of its search engine and had to 'beg' the co-founders to return. 'Degraded' and 'ask' do not match those words. The co-founder involvement can be checked; the link to search quality is his interpretation.

entries.test: Reported size of Microsoft's January 2023 investment in OpenAI (widely reported as about $10 billion), OpenAI's headcount at the time, and the timing of Microsoft's 10,000-person layoff announcement.
entries.note: The investment was widely reported as $10 billion, not $14 billion. Identifying the competitor as Microsoft is inferred, but it is the plain reading.
